name: The Princess Diaries
source:
Every little girl's dream is to be a pretty princess living in a big castle filled with servants, banquets, and balls, and to be courted by handsome princes on white horses. The reality is much, much worse as Hazel is about to find out. Princes are not always handsome. Your needs are totally ignored. And you are closer to a slave than even the poor handmaidens.
Join Hazel as the reality of coming of age as a princess catches up with her. But Hazel finds a glimmer of hope in her predicament from the most unlikely of sources, her sweet mom...​
